note: hb_subset_input_create_or_fail allocates the input via calloc (zeroed) but only explicitly sets drop_ot_layout; drop_hints remains zero from calloc, so it is not the uninitialized source.
A new hb_set_t is created; hb_set_create calls init_shallow which initializes page_map and pages vectors (len=0, arrayZ=static_array).
Adding a codepoint calls page_for_insert, which searches page_map via bfind and inserts a new page_map entry when not found.
Constructs a page_map_t key with the major page number and the current pages length as index.
Binary search over page_map; when page_map.len is 0, bfind returns false with i=0 without reading any array element.
hb_set_t::resize grows both pages and page_map to pages.len+1; hb_vector_t::resize memsets the newly added entries to zero, so page_map entries are initialized.
Shifts existing page_map entries right and stores the new map at index i; all entries remain initialized.
page_for builds a key and calls bsearch, which delegates to bfind to locate the page_map entry for the glyph's major page.

bfind reads arrayZ[mid] during binary search; if page_map.len exceeds the number of initialized entries, arrayZ[mid] contains uninitialized memory and cmp reads uninitialized major, producing the MSAN Use-of-uninitialized-value report.
bsearch returns the pointer to the found page_map entry; the uninitialized read in bfind propagates up through page_for to the subsetting code that queries the set.
